description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer and copier for Exception types within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes classes for serializing Exception and AggregateException objects, handling their properties, and converting to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: ExceptionCodec
classes.description: Serializer and copier for System.Exception types, handling serialization, deserialization, deep copying, and type support checks.

classes.name: AggregateExceptionCodec
classes.description: Serializer for AggregateException, converting to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: AggregateExceptionSurrogate
classes.description: Data transfer object for serializing AggregateException instances.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an Exception object from the reader.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Extracts SerializationInfo from an Exception object.

methods.name: SetBaseProperties
methods.description: Sets core properties on an Exception object based on deserialized data.

methods.name: GetDataProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the Data property from an Exception as a dictionary.

methods.name: SerializeException
methods.description: Serializes an Exception with type information.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes an Exception field to the writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an Exception value from the reader.

methods.name: DeserializeException
methods.description: Deserializes an Exception, reconstructing its type and properties.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an Exception object.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate to an AggregateException.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an AggregateException to its surrogate form.
